title: 第161章 黑山羊 你早就知道了第160章 黑水龙宫黑水真龙尸体
slug: 开局被退婚反手娶小姨子
lines: “我知道啊。”青龙道人如道寻常一样回答，声音没有半点起伏，也没有震惊。
平淡的眼神注视着黑山羊，那副无需如此大惊小怪的模样，让黑山羊顿时无语了，它不解问：“既然你早就知道了，为何不告诉老子，亏老子还以为你不知道，特意跟你说这个大发现，结果……”
黑山羊郁闷极了，它以为就它知道这个秘密，高高兴兴来告诉青龙道人，特意让他震惊一下，然后展现自己的厉害，谁知道，一切都是它一厢情愿。
原来青龙道人早就知道了，也就是说陈初阳那个小子也发现了？
“为何要告诉你？我以为你早就发现了，谁能想到你一直没发现，早知道这样，我应该告诉你的。”青龙道人这话更加气人，不说还好，说了，更加令人生气。
它幽怨扫了一眼青龙道人，那眼神，似乎要杀死青龙道人很多次。
青龙道人浑然不在乎，继续说：“你这也不行啊，亏我我还以为你早就发现了，原来，你现在才发现，看来是我高估你了。”
黑山羊嘴硬道：“老子早就发现了，只是老子没有告诉你而已。”
青龙道人深深看着它，那眼神，让黑山羊十分难受，黑山羊承受不住，低头道：“好吧，老子是刚刚刚发现的，那个地方隐藏得非常好，单独的空间洞天隐藏起来，还设置了一系列的阵法，哪怕是老子，也忽略了，若不是老子天性谨慎，可能还真的发现不了这个地方。”
“小子，以你的修为和实力，不可能发现得了，是不是陈初阳那个小子发现的？”
黑山羊发现了盲点，立刻盯着青龙道人，青龙道人的眼光和实力，不可能发现得了那个地方。
青龙道人笑着说：“是我发现的。”
“呵呵，老子才不信你，你小子就喜欢扯大旗，狐假虎威，肯定是陈初阳那个小子发现的，唯有陈初阳这个小子才会如此……敏锐，能够第一时间发现不对劲。”
“你小子的话，再给你十年时间，你也不见得可以发现龙宫的存在。”
不是黑山羊瞧不起他，而是黑山羊是真的……鄙视他。
不认为青龙道人可以做到，它都做不到，青龙道人怎么可能做得到呢。
“你就这么小看我？”
“错了，不是小看你，而是老子太了解你了。”黑山羊太了解陈初阳，也了解青龙道人，此人，虽说是陈初阳的分身之一，可是他是单独存在的，性格也好，各方面也罢，都是单独的人。
不同于陈初阳的性格，天生带着青龙一族的脾气和性格，当然了，他也拥有陈初阳的谨慎和小心。
眼光方面，不如陈初阳，实力就不用说了，不在一个级别上。
“哈哈哈，黑山羊，看来还是你了解我，不错，黑水龙宫不是我发现的，不过，我也去过下面，见过那个黑水龙宫，里面很危险，可不好进入。”
“这个黑水龙宫单独形成一个洞天，阵法封锁，不允许外人进去，想要进去里面，没那么容易。”
“而且，里面并不安全，以我现在的修为，不适合进去。”
青龙道人暂时不想进去里面，只想要提升修为和实力，这才是重点。
他本身就是青龙血脉，也是真龙血脉，不弱于黑水龙宫那一具真龙尸体，他有种预感，黑水龙宫的那具尸体不简单，估计也在等着他进去里面。
content_en:
"I know." Qinglong Taoist replied as usual, his voice did not fluctuate at all, nor was he shocked.
The black goat was staring at the black goat with dull eyes. The look that there was no need to make such a fuss made the black goat speechless. It asked puzzledly: "Since you have known it for a long time, why didn't you tell me? Unfortunately, I thought you didn't know, so I told you this big discovery specially, but it turned out..."
The black goat was extremely depressed. He thought he was the only one who knew the secret, so he happily told Taoist Qinglong, specifically to shock him, and then show off his power. Who knew that everything was just wishful thinking on his part.
It turns out that Taoist Qinglong had known about it for a long time. In other words, that boy Chen Chuyang also found out?
"Why should I tell you? I thought you had discovered it a long time ago. Who would have thought that you had never discovered it? If I had known this, I should have told you." Taoist Qinglong's words are even more irritating. It would be better if he didn't say it, but if he did, it would be even more irritating.
Black Goat: "..."
It cast a resentful glance at Taoist Qinglong, with a look that seemed to kill Taoist Qinglong many times.
Taoist Qinglong didn't care at all and continued: "You can't do this either. Fortunately for me, I thought you had discovered it a long time ago. It turns out that you only discovered it now. It seems that I overestimated you."
Black Goat said harshly: "I have discovered it a long time ago, but I didn't tell you."
Taoist Qinglong looked at it deeply. That look made Black Goat very uncomfortable. Black Goat couldn't bear it and lowered his head and said, "Okay, I just discovered it. That place is very well hidden. A separate space is hidden in the sky. A series of formations were also set up. Even I ignored it. If I hadn't been cautious by nature, I might not have been able to discover this place."
"Boy, with your cultivation and strength, it is impossible to discover it. Did that boy Chen Chuyang discover it?"
Black Goat discovered the blind spot and immediately stared at Taoist Qinglong. With Taoist Qinglong's vision and strength, it was impossible to find that place.
Taoist Qinglong smiled and said, "I discovered it."
"Haha, I don't believe you. You just like to pull big flags and pretend to be powerful. That boy Chen Chuyang must have discovered it. Only this boy Chen Chuyang can be so... keen and be able to detect something wrong at the first time."
"As for you kid, if I give you another ten years, you may not be able to discover the existence of Dragon Palace."
It's not that the Black Goat looks down on him, it's that the Black Goat really... despises him.
I don’t think Taoist Qinglong can do it. It can’t do it. How could Taoist Qinglong do it?
"You just underestimate me so much?"
"Wrong, it's not that I underestimate you, but I know you too well." Black Goat knows Chen Chuyang too well, and he also knows Taoist Qinglong. Although this person is one of Chen Chuyang's clones, he exists alone. Regardless of his personality or all aspects, he is an independent person.
Different from Chen Chuyang's character, he was born with the temper and character of the Qinglong clan. Of course, he also has Chen Chuyang's caution and caution.
In terms of vision, he is not as good as Chen Chuyang. Needless to say, his strength is not on the same level.
"Hahaha, Black Goat, it seems you understand me. Yes, I did not discover the Blackwater Dragon Palace. However, I have also been down there and seen the Blackwater Dragon Palace. It is very dangerous inside and is not easy to enter."
"This Blackwater Dragon Palace forms a separate cave. It is sealed by formations and no outsiders are allowed to enter. It is not that easy to get inside."
"Besides, it's not safe inside. With my current level of cultivation, I'm not suitable to go in."
Taoist Qinglong doesn't want to go inside for the time being. He just wants to improve his cultivation and strength. This is the key point.
He himself is of Azure Dragon bloodline, and also of True Dragon bloodline, and is not weaker than the True Dragon corpse in Blackwater Dragon Palace. He has a hunch that the corpse in Blackwater Dragon Palace is not simple, and is probably waiting for him to go inside.
